Maya Patel: Heads-up: new convo to lock down onboarding terms for open model 'Orion-2' with partner SkyForge (HW) and HarborSI. Main questions: allow partner-distributed quantized artifacts? marketplace packaging? PR embargo?
Diego Alvarez: I can take packaging. Recommend marketplace bundle = small stub + signed manifest; large kernel packs via authenticated partner link. Keeps uploads under limits.
Sasha (Legal): Legal default: partners may distribute only integrated, quantized runtime artifacts. Redistribution of raw checkpoints requires exception workflow (export control + indemnity). I'll draft addendum language.
Priya Nair: Marketing note: SkyForge asks for co-branding and wants the phrase "on-appliance optimized runtime" instead of "on-device weights." Also request logo approval by 2024-07-01.
Rae Chen: Runtime note: Redwood supports q4_8 and q8_0. We can produce a no-telemetry build for marketplace and a telemetry-enabled sandbox for SI testing. We'll attach a signed manifest with build_id and sha256.
Sasha (Legal): Also adding clause: "Partner must not modify provenance or re-enable telemetry without Redwood written consent." Will include marketplace checkbox for export control.
Diego Alvarez: Action items: I'll produce sample manifest schema and a stub artifact by 2024-06-10. Priya please confirm PR copy.
Priya Nair: Will draft PR-safe blurb and coordinate logo approvals. Target draft by 2024-06-15.
Maya Patel: Good. Sasha draft due 2024-06-05. Follow-up sync next Tuesday to confirm builds and legal sign-off. -- Maya
